Hi everyone,
this is my first post here, so please forgive me some rookie mistakes I might have made.
I found a similar question like mine before: https://leanprover-community.github.io/archive/stream/270676-lean4/topic/Term.20reduction.20in.20type.html
The last elab is working for me but not inside of a proof. There is of course cast and it does work for converting the type, but I cannot continue my proof once I use it.
My problem arises in the untyped (call-by-need) lambda calculus when trying to proof that for every multicontext (lambda-code with arbitrary many holes) there exists a smaller n-1-multicontext having one hole less.

import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic

namespace LambdaLet

abbrev Var := Nat
abbrev Perm := Equiv.Perm Var

/-
  Raw named syntax.

  Intended reading: terms satisfy Barendregt's convention, so a global permutation
  that fixes all free variables acts as α-renaming of binders.
-/
inductive Expr where
  | var  : Var → Expr
  | lam  : Var → Expr → Expr
  | app  : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | letE : Var → Expr → Expr → Expr
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive MultiCtx : Nat → Type
  | atom  : Expr → MultiCtx 0
  | hole  : MultiCtx 1
  | lam   : Var → MultiCtx n  → MultiCtx n
  | app   : MultiCtx m → MultiCtx n → MultiCtx (m + n)
  | letE  : Var → MultiCtx m → MultiCtx n → MultiCtx (m + n)
deriving Repr


namespace MultiCtx

def fill {n : Nat} (mc : MultiCtx n) (τ : (Fin n → Expr)) : Expr :=
  match mc, τ with
  | atom e, _    => e
  | hole, σ      => σ 0
  | lam x C, σ   => Expr.lam x (fill C σ)
  | @app (m:Nat) (k:Nat) C D, σ =>
      Expr.app
        -- A new function is created to be able to use σ for getting the filling expressions.
        -- castAdd is used to make i compatible with the input to σ.
        (fill C (fun i : (Fin m) => σ (Fin.castAdd k i)))
        -- similar to the above, but the holes in C have to be skipped
        (fill D (fun j : (Fin k) => σ (Fin.natAdd m j)))
  | @letE m o x C D, σ =>
      Expr.letE x
        (fill C (fun i => σ (Fin.castAdd o i)))
        (fill D (fun j => σ (Fin.natAdd m j)))

theorem fill_expr_stays_same :
  ∀ {k : Nat} (m : MultiCtx k), k = 0 →
  ∃ s : Expr, ∀ τ : (Fin k → Expr), m.fill τ = s := by
  intro K M Z
  match M with
  | atom e => refine ⟨e,?_⟩; simp[MultiCtx.fill]
  | lam x C => simp only [MultiCtx.fill]
               have q : ∃ t, ∀ (σ : Fin K → Expr),  Expr.lam x (C.fill σ) =  Expr.lam x t := by simp only [fill_expr_stays_same C Z, Expr.lam.injEq, true_and]
               rcases q with ⟨w, h⟩
               exact ⟨Expr.lam x w, h⟩
  | @app m 0 C D => simp only [Nat.add_zero]
                    simp only [ Nat.add_zero] at Z;
                    revert C
                    rw[Z]
                    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_zero_pi, exists_eq', implies_true]
  | @letE m 0 x C D => simp only [Nat.add_zero]
                       simp only [ Nat.add_zero] at Z;
                       revert C
                       rw[Z]
                       simp only [Fin.forall_fin_zero_pi, exists_eq', implies_true]

def opt_incr (j : Fin N) (n : Fin (N - 1)) : Fin N :=
  if h : n.toNat >= j.toNat then (n.addNat 1).cast (by simp_all [Fin.toNat] ; grind only)
  else n.castLE (by grind only)

instance : CoeDep (Expr) e (MultiCtx 0) where
  coe := MultiCtx.atom e

instance : CoeDep (MultiCtx 0) (MultiCtx.atom e) Expr where
  coe := e

theorem Fin.zero (j : Fin 1) : j = 0 := by grind only

@[coe]
def fincast : Fin (0+n) → Fin n
  | ⟨k, h⟩ =>
    have he : 0+n = n := by simp only [Nat.zero_add]
    ⟨k, Eq.subst he h⟩

instance : Coe (Fin (0+α)) (Fin α) := ⟨fincast⟩

/-
For every MultiCtx with more than zero holes, there exists an equivalent MultiCtx with one hole less
-/

theorem MultiCtx.fill_once :
  ∀ (N : Nat) (h : N > 0) (j : Fin N) (n : MultiCtx N) (σ : Fin N → Expr), ∃ (m : MultiCtx (N-1)),
  n.fill σ = m.fill (fun i => σ (opt_incr j i)) :=
  by
    rintro N h j n σ
    fun_induction MultiCtx.fill
    case case1 =>
      contradiction
    case case2 τ =>
      simp_all only [gt_iff_lt, zero_lt_one, Nat.add_one_sub_one, Fin.isValue]
      let k := τ j
      have h0 : 0=0 → ∃ s, ∀ (τ : Fin 0 → Expr), (atom k).fill τ = s :=by exact MultiCtx.fill_expr_stays_same (atom k)
      specialize h0 rfl
      rcases h0 with ⟨s, hs⟩
      have heq : k = s := by simp_all only [fill, forall_const]
      use k
      specialize hs fun i ↦ τ (opt_incr j i)
      rw[hs]
      have jz : j = 0 := by apply Fin.zero
      rw[← heq]
      grind only
    case case3 x a m hn hx =>
      apply hx at h
      specialize h j
      rcases h with ⟨o, ho⟩
      use MultiCtx.lam a o
      simp_all only [MultiCtx.fill]
    case case4 m n Mm Mn σ hadd hn =>
      have k := m + n
      simp_all only [gt_iff_lt, MultiCtx.fill]
      cases m
      case zero =>
        simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
        specialize hn h
        specialize hn j
        rcases hn with ⟨w, hw⟩
        induction j
        case mk v hv =>
        simp only [lt_self_iff_false, Nat.zero_sub_one, IsEmpty.forall_iff] at hadd
        simp only [Nat.zero_add] at hv
        next hvi =>
        have h0 : 0=0 → ∃ s, ∀ (τ : Fin 0 → Expr), Mm.fill τ = s :=by exact MultiCtx.fill_expr_stays_same Mm
        specialize h0 rfl
        rcases h0 with ⟨e, he⟩
        specialize he fun i ↦ σ (Fin.castAdd n i)
        have hq :  (MultiCtx (0 + (n - 1))) = (MultiCtx (0 + n - 1)) := by grind only
        let k := cast hq (MultiCtx.app (MultiCtx.atom e) (w : MultiCtx (n-1)))
        use k
        rw[hw]
        rw[he]
        simp_all only [Fin.natAdd_zero, Fin.cast]
        simp_rw [k]
        beta_reduce at σ
        sorry
      case succ =>
        sorry
    case case5 => sorry

end MultiCtx

Could there be a way to coerce between MultiCtx N and MultiCtx M by calculating the number of holes? I tried this approach but failed since i cannot create a term with type MultiCtx M if I have one with type MultiCtx N.
Regards

I'm not sure what your point was but you should probably write a helper function instead of an existence proof:

import Mathlib

@[grind =]
def Fin.insertAt (i : Fin n) (x : α) (f : Fin (n - 1) → α) : Fin n → α :=
  fun j => if h : j < i then f ⟨j, by lia⟩ else if h : j = i then x else f ⟨j.1 - 1, by lia⟩

namespace LambdaLet

abbrev Var := Nat
abbrev Perm := Equiv.Perm Var

inductive Expr where
  | var  : Var → Expr
  | lam  : Var → Expr → Expr
  | app  : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | letE : Var → Expr → Expr → Expr
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive MultiCtx : Nat → Type
  | atom  : Expr → MultiCtx 0
  | hole  : MultiCtx 1
  | lam   : Var → MultiCtx n → MultiCtx n
  | app   : MultiCtx m → MultiCtx n → MultiCtx (m + n)
  | letE  : Var → MultiCtx m → MultiCtx n → MultiCtx (m + n)
deriving Repr


namespace MultiCtx

def fill {n : Nat} (mc : MultiCtx n) (τ : Fin n → Expr) : Expr :=
  match mc, τ with
  | atom e, _    => e
  | hole, σ      => σ 0
  | lam x C, σ   => Expr.lam x (fill C σ)
  | @app (m:Nat) (k:Nat) C D, σ =>
      Expr.app
        (fill C (fun i : Fin m => σ (Fin.castAdd k i)))
        (fill D (fun j : Fin k => σ (Fin.natAdd m j)))
  | @letE m o x C D, σ =>
      Expr.letE x
        (fill C (fun i => σ (Fin.castAdd o i)))
        (fill D (fun j => σ (Fin.natAdd m j)))

theorem fill_expr_stays_same {k : Nat} (m : MultiCtx k) (hk : k = 0) :
    ∃ s : Expr, ∀ τ : Fin k → Expr, m.fill τ = s := by
  subst hk
  use m.fill finZeroElim
  simp

example (j : Fin (N + 1)) (n : Fin N) : opt_incr j n = Fin.succAbove j n := by
  ext; simp [Fin.succAbove, opt_incr, apply_ite Fin.val, Fin.lt_def]
  grind

@[grind =]
def cast (x : MultiCtx n) (h : n = m) : MultiCtx m := h ▸ x

@[simp] theorem cast_self : cast x rfl = x := by rfl
@[simp] theorem cast_cast : cast (cast x h) h' = cast x (h.trans h') := by subst h h'; rfl
@[simp] theorem fill_cast : fill (cast x h) τ = fill x fun i => τ (i.cast h) := by subst h; rfl
@[simp] theorem lam_cast : lam v (cast x h) = cast (lam v x) h := by subst h; rfl
@[simp] theorem app_cast_left : app (cast f h) a = cast (app f a) (by simp [h]) := by subst h; rfl
@[simp] theorem app_cast_right : app f (cast a h) = cast (app f a) (by simp [h]) := by subst h; rfl
@[simp] theorem letE_cast_left : letE v (cast f h) a = cast (letE v f a) (by simp [h]) := by subst h; rfl
@[simp] theorem letE_cast_right : letE v f (cast a h) = cast (letE v f a) (by simp [h]) := by subst h; rfl

def instantiate (m : MultiCtx n) (j : Fin n) (e : Expr) : MultiCtx (n - 1) :=
  match m with
  | .hole => .atom e
  | .lam v b => .lam v (b.instantiate j e)
  | .app f a =>
    j.addCases
      (fun j => (app (f.instantiate j e) a).cast (by have := j.pos; lia))
      (fun j => (app f (a.instantiate j e)).cast (by have := j.pos; lia))
  | .letE v l r =>
    j.addCases
      (fun j => (letE v (l.instantiate j e) r).cast (by have := j.pos; lia))
      (fun j => (letE v l (r.instantiate j e)).cast (by have := j.pos; lia))

theorem fill_instantiate (N : Nat) (j : Fin N) (n : MultiCtx N) (e : Expr) (σ : Fin (N - 1) → Expr) :
    (n.instantiate j e).fill σ = n.fill (fun i => Fin.insertAt j e σ i) := by
  fun_induction instantiate <;>
    simp [Fin.addCases, apply_dite (fill · σ), fill, Fin.natAdd, Fin.castLT, Fin.cast, *] <;>
    grind [fill]

end MultiCtx

end LambdaLet

Of course, fill_once is a simple corollary:

theorem fill_once :
    ∀ (N : Nat) (j : Fin N) (n : MultiCtx N) (σ : Fin N → Expr), ∃ (m : MultiCtx (N-1)),
    n.fill σ = m.fill (fun i => σ (opt_incr j i)) := by
  intro N j n σ
  use n.instantiate j (σ j)
  rw [fill_instantiate]
  congr; ext i; grind [= Fin.cast, = Fin.castLE, = opt_incr]

Yeah, this seems to be the case.
Thank you very much for this awesome help.
